answer_1.quote: We perform two tasks to evaluate how GPT comprehends these PoC tokens... Interpretation task aims to measure GPT's comprehension of PoC tokens... Repetition task aims to measure GPT's external generation capability of PoC tokens.

answer_2.quote: The repetition task... is measured by verbatim match.

answer_3.quote: The former [interpretation task] is measured by DeepSeek-V3 with strong Chinese capabilities...
